messages.content:
뒤섞인 운영 입력을 다음 개선 검토로 정리해줘: 충돌하는 스프레드시트의 KPI 검토
맥락: 두 시트가 같은 전환율에 다른 분모를 쓰고 하나에는 오래된 월 표기가 있다.
산출물: 정의, 날짜, 미해결 값을 담은 대조표
호환되지 않는 KPI 값을 평균 내지 않는다.
충돌 KPI 시트 — 같은 전환율, 다른 분모, 오래된 월 표기 — 정의·날짜·미해결 값 대조표.

Turn these messy operational inputs into an improvement review for a KPI review from conflicting spreadsheets. Context: Two sheets use different denominators for the same conversion rate and one has a stale month label. Deliver: a reconciliation table with definitions, dates, and unresolved values. Do not average incompatible KPI values.
Conflicting KPI sheets — same conversion rate, different denominators; stale month label — reconciliation table: definitions, dates, unresolved values.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a KPI review from conflicting spreadsheets.
Do not average incompatible KPI values.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a KPI review from conflicting spreadsheets.
Do not average incompatible KPI values.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
